action.description: plan checks the instance and reports the access execute would grant without changing anything. execute grants the access (or revokes it with revoke: true) and removes expired access to the instance.

zone.description: Zone of the instance, e.g. us-central1-a.

instance.description: Name of the Compute Engine instance, in the project of the function. It needs OS Login enabled.

principal.description: Email of the user or service account that gets the access. Service accounts are recognised by their .gserviceaccount.com domain.

role.description: user logs in without sudo (roles/compute.osLogin), admin with sudo (roles/compute.osAdminLogin).

durationMinutes.description: How long the access lasts, at most the installation's limit. Granting again extends it and never shortens it.

revoke.description: Remove the principal's access to the instance instead of granting it.
